doc.name: CORONA
doc.title: THE NORTHERN CROWN
doc.blurb: The sky's real crown: seven stars in a bowl, opening downward as it does over the north in spring. Alphecca, the gem, is the white wish-star and the eye, dipping every seventeen seconds because it is two stars eclipsing. Inside the rim T Coronae, the Blaze Star, breathes red on a thirty-second swell; one night soon it goes off for real.
